sender.hr: „Kupac“ s Njuškala, OLX-a, Facebook Marketplacea ili sličnog oglasnika
sender.en: A “buyer” from Njuškalo, OLX, Facebook Marketplace or a similar classifieds site

name.hr: Lažni kupac na oglasniku: „poslao sam vam poveznicu da primite uplatu“
name.en: Fake buyer on a classifieds site: “I sent you a link to receive the payment”

how.hr: Prodajete nešto na oglasniku i brzo se javlja kupac, često preko WhatsAppa ili SMS-a, izvan poruka oglasnika. Ne pregovara, ne dolazi po stvar nego „šalje dostavu“ i poveznicu na kojoj trebate „primiti uplatu“. Stranica izgleda kao oglasnik, dostavna služba ili banka i traži osobne podatke, broj kartice i CVV ili kod iz tokena. Umjesto da primite novac, novac odlazi s vašeg računa.
how.en: You are selling something on a classifieds site and a buyer gets in touch quickly, often via WhatsApp or text, outside the site’s messages. They don’t haggle or come to collect; they “send a courier” and a link where you must “receive the payment”. The page looks like the classifieds site, a courier or a bank and asks for personal details, card number and CVV or a token code. Instead of receiving money, money leaves your account.

text.hr: Kupac se javlja odmah i prelazi na WhatsApp ili SMS.
text.en: A buyer replies at once and moves to WhatsApp or text.

text.hr: Plaća unaprijed i šalje dostavu, bez dolaska.
text.en: They pay up front and send a courier, without coming.
They send a link to “receive the payment”.

text.hr: Stranica traži karticu, CVV ili kod tokena.
text.en: The page asks for your card, CVV or a token code.

text.hr: Pozdrav, je li bicikl još dostupan? Uzimam ga po cijeni iz oglasa, ali sam u Osijeku pa ću poslati dostavu, sve sam već platio. Samo potvrdite primitak novca na kartici ovdje i kurir dolazi sutra: [poveznica]
text.en: Hi, is the bike still available? I’ll take it at the advertised price, but I’m in Osijek so I’ll send a courier, I’ve already paid for everything. Just confirm receipt of the money on your card here and the courier comes tomorrow: [link]

hr: kupac traži podatke kartice primitak novca
en: fake buyer on classifieds sent a link
njuskalo buyer sending a courier link
receive payment enter card and cvv
selling online money taken from my account
buyer asked for card details to receive money

hr: Da biste primili novac, nikad ne trebate upisati broj kartice, CVV ni kod iz tokena.
Kupac odmah traži kontakt izvan oglasnika.
Ne pregovara, ne želi vidjeti stvar i sam „organizira dostavu“.
en: To receive money you never need to enter your card number, CVV or a token code.
The buyer wants to talk off the site straight away.
They don’t haggle, don’t want to see the item and “arrange the delivery” themselves.

hr: Dopisujte se samo kroz poruke oglasnika i dogovorite osobnu primopredaju.
Ne otvarajte poveznice od kupaca. Za uplatu kupcu dajte samo IBAN.
Ako ste upisali karticu, odmah nazovite banku i prijavite policiji.
en: Only chat through the site’s messages and arrange to hand over in person.
Don’t open links from buyers. Give a buyer only your IBAN.
If you entered your card, call your bank at once and report it to the police.
